title: Story-to-brain language encoding
scientific_question: Can training stories predict the same listener's 400-parcel BOLD response to a wholly withheld story family, and does case-adaptive analysis improve that prediction under matched information?
primary_outputs: The withheld scan-aligned BOLD time series, independently read by the evaluator; story identity or published ISC is not the answer.

missing_or_unverified: No exact input asset record was extracted from the linked readiness manifest; inspect the pinned source audit before acquisition.
This specification does not establish a local public/private packet, payload equality or an executed task adapter.

inputs: Allowed same-listener training BOLD (400 fixed parcels) and transcript/acoustic features with verified scanner-clock rows.
Frozen NUISANCE, LEXICAL and CONTEXT arms: timing/acoustics, static GPT-2 lexical features, and past/present contextual features; trained transforms use training support only.
forbidden_inputs: Query BOLD, target means/digests or label-bearing identities; ZERO_RESPONSE views must not carry REAL training-response identities.
Future story words, cross-family passages and response-selected preprocessing fitted on the query.
allowed_inputs.case_identity: Source plan requires opaque case/context identities and joins to listener, family, run, segment and ordered row. There are 486 planned cases; no admitted public native case packet ships.
allowed_inputs.split: Within-listener leave-story-family-out; every retelling, shared passage and run segment stays grouped, with hemodynamic/context guards. Inner family selection is training-local; listeners with a single family are ineligible.
allowed_inputs.coverage: Source plan retains 345 people/873 scans, 171 eligible listeners/572 eligible scans and 486 cases. The current upstream README says 891 scans; therefore these are version-specific planned counts, not a freshly authenticated current corpus census. All400 parcels, 5,832 candidate contexts and4,374 reference contexts remain required by this selected plan.

biological_unit: Listener, with crossed dependence induced by shared story families; scans and parcels are repeated measurements.
case_definition: One eligible listener × withheld story-family case, retaining every run and segment.

split.policy: Within-listener leave-story-family-out; every retelling, shared passage and run segment stays grouped, with hemodynamic/context guards. Inner family selection is training-local; listeners with a single family are ineligible.
split.coverage: Source plan retains 345 people/873 scans, 171 eligible listeners/572 eligible scans and 486 cases. The current upstream README says 891 scans; therefore these are version-specific planned counts, not a freshly authenticated current corpus census. All400 parcels, 5,832 candidate contexts and4,374 reference contexts remain required by this selected plan.

reference.role: Pinned author preprocessing, timing and reliability source. ISC is not an encoding baseline; a separate source-locked encoder and clock adapter are required.

controls: REAL-minus-ZERO checks access to training responses; it is not a test of native neural understanding.
Story families and repeated passages grouped; per-scan audio onset must not be rounded or borrowed from another listener.
Disclose the response-selected layer prior despite fit-local transforms; retain atypical TR scans and scrambled variants.

direct_observation.representation: The target is a400-parcel response time series from stimuli and training data, not a case label inferred from a presented neural observation.
direct_observation.boundary: Showing target BOLD would change this encoding target; a direct-interpretation question requires a separately specified endpoint.

typed_viewer.representation: No typed neural viewer implements the current encoding target.
typed_viewer.boundary: A plot of held-out target response cannot be candidate input without changing the estimand.

tool_assisted.representation: I arm may inspect current query features and perform case-specific numerical/model analysis.
tool_assisted.boundary: Same feature arm, permitted training responses and accounted resources as F; target responses and reference bank remain inaccessible.
missing: Qualified participant launcher and authentic packets

frozen_program.representation: F programme authored before query features, then fit state and query inference separated.
frozen_program.boundary: Freeze method and fit recipe before query; only declared training-local adaptation.
missing: Qualified native operator/runtime and complete reference bank

primary.name: Listener-macro signed Pearson response correlation
primary.aggregation: Mean400 parcel correlations within segment, equal segment means within run, equal run means within case, equal case means within listener, then equal171-listener mean; F and I reported separately.
primary.rationale: Grades prediction of actual held-out BOLD while preventing long scans or many parcels from becoming extra biological replications.

secondary: Training-mean-referenced Q² and MSE on exactly the same support.
All57 prespecified access/feature/REAL-minus-ZERO contrasts and story-family descriptive marginals.
Report constant-target undefined values and ineligible listeners; do not replace undefined correlations with favorable omissions.

comparators.name: Rmean
comparators.procedure: Source computes hierarchical weighted training mean; mandatory intercept comparator.

comparators.name: R0 and R2
comparators.inputs: Identical timing/acoustic/lexical/context feature arms and training responses
comparators.procedure: Source R0 uses training-only16-PC ridge; R2 uses full-feature group-regularized kernel ridge with training-family inner selection. Separate nine-reference bank requires actual qualified fits.

comparators.name: Rtemp and Racoustic
comparators.procedure: Source-defined nuisance references; no claim that acoustics exhaust all phonological confounds.

nuisance_controls: REAL-minus-ZERO checks access to training responses; it is not a test of native neural understanding.
Story families and repeated passages grouped; per-scan audio onset must not be rounded or borrowed from another listener.
Disclose the response-selected layer prior despite fit-local transforms; retain atypical TR scans and scrambled variants.
evaluation.uncertainty: Current scorer gives descriptive listener values and dependent unbalanced story-family marginals; it deliberately supplies no IID significance or population causal claim. Any future inferential extension must preserve crossed listener/story dependence.
evaluation.failure_policy: Require every 486 case and21 condition score. Undefined parcel metrics propagate to complete-support means; wrong dimensions, nonfinite outputs, missing cases or failed references cannot silently reduce support.

resources.basis: Unmeasured estimate. Use bounded existing derivatives/reference features; full-source procurement and model training are not implied.

holds.requirement: Audit story/transcript alignment, participant aliases and exact release-specific derivatives.
Collection includes multiple experiments; keep one catalog source and map story/participant overlaps before assessment.
Retrieve bounded versioned manifests/schema and verify actual recording inputs, labels, alignment and biological identity; catalog identity alone is insufficient.
Pin exact official code revision/entrypoint and license, inspect loader-to-data compatibility, and select a meaningful signal-derived reference.
Audit data, stimulus, code and checkpoint access/redistribution terms before packet distribution.
Freeze exact sample eligibility, target definition, primary metric, split, access rules and resource budget before outcomes.
Implement and run data adapter/evaluator/reference, matched controls and malformed-output tests; independently reproduce results before any validation claim.
